title: Missing value imputation with adversarial random forests - MissARF
abstract: arXiv:2507.15681v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Handling missing values is a common challenge in biostatistical analyses, typically addressed by imputation methods. We propose a novel, fast, and easy-to-use imputation method called missing value imputation with adversarial random forests (MissARF), based on generative machine learning, that provides both single and multiple imputation. MissARF employs adversarial random forest (ARF) for density estimation and data synthesis. To impute a missing value of an observation, we condition on the non-missing values and sample from the estimated conditional distribution generated by ARF. Our experiments demonstrate that MissARF performs comparably to state-of-the-art single and multiple imputation methods in terms of imputation quality and fast runtime with no additional costs for multiple imputation.

translated_title: 基于对抗性随机森林的缺失值插补方法——MissARF
translated_abstract: 处理缺失值是生物统计分析中的一个常见挑战，通常通过插补方法来解决。我们提出了一种新颖、快速且易于使用的插补方法，称为基于对抗性随机森林的缺失值插补（MissARF），该方法基于生成式机器学习，可同时提供单重插补和多重插补。MissARF利用对抗性随机森林（ARF）进行密度估计和数据合成。为了插补某个观测值的缺失值，我们以该观测的非缺失值为条件，从ARF生成的估计条件分布中进行采样。我们的实验表明，MissARF在插补质量和运行速度方面与最先进的单重和多重插补方法表现相当，且多重插补无需额外的计算成本。
tldr: MissARF是一种基于对抗性随机森林的快速缺失值插补方法，可在提供高质量单重与多重插补的同时，使多重插补无需额外计算成本。
en_tdlr: MissARF is a fast missing value imputation method based on adversarial random forests that delivers high-quality single and multiple imputation with no additional computational cost for multiple imputation.
